name: glassmorphism-ui
description: Frosted-glass surfaces — the translucent-depth language in which the backdrop is BLURRED AND NOTHING ELSE, never geometrically warped and never behind a perspective camera. Emits the five-rung backdrop-blur elevation ladder with a matching opaque mirror, rewrites target components with the @supports fallback and the four accessibility escape hatches baked in, and measures every text pair against the worst-case composited backdrop rather than the declared background-color. A refracting backdrop is liquid-glass-ui; panels at translateZ under a camera are spatial-ui.
